In this video, I’m showing you how I protect basement floors from moisture using DMX 1-Step 2.0 and why water underneath your floor isn’t the disaster most people think it is.
A lot of homeowners worry about moisture in the basement ruining their flooring. The truth is, you’re not trying to stop water completely, you’re managing it properly.
This underlayment works like a hybrid subfloor. If water gets in, it doesn’t sit against your flooring. Instead, it moves underneath the membrane, displacing air and keeping the top surface dry, even if the underside is soaking wet.
